title: Pulse Networking Night 2027
objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni
resources: Venue booking, sound system and a volunteer team of 20 students
risks: Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 67 attendees for this Networking Night, in line with turnout at our previous Networking Night events.
The requested budget of INR 24,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Networking Night.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
